name: OAuthPublishedApps
description:
These APIs enable administrators to view all the available published OAuth applications in Databricks.
Administrators can add the published OAuth applications to their account through the OAuth Published App Integration APIs.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Get all the available published OAuth apps in Databricks.
methods.summary: Get all the published OAuth apps.

all_fields.name: page_size
all_fields.description: The max number of OAuth published apps to return in one page.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description: A token that can be used to get the next page of results.
